items.text: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.65

A.actClause: AN ACT to amend the workers' compensation law, in relation to the establishment of rates of payment and delivery of health care services

summary: Relates to the establishment of rates of payment and delivery of health care services; directs the chair of the workers' compensation board to biennially prepare and establish a schedule of fees.
title: Relates to the establishment of rates of payment and delivery of health care services
